spec_dod.text: `thumbnail-worker` consuming a well-formed message from `image-queue` processes it and acks it exactly once.
A message that fails processing 4 times in a row is moved to the poison-message queue, not requeued forever.
`thumbnail-worker` never acks a message before processing completes (an ack-before-process would lose messages on a crash).
Two workers consuming `image-queue` concurrently never both process the same message (no double-processing under concurrency).
The poison-queue alert gives an operator enough to triage without replaying the message by hand first.

recordings.outcome: ack sent only after processing completes

recordings.queue_event: worker-A and worker-B both receive msg-4 concurrently
recordings.outcome: exactly one of worker-A/worker-B processed msg-4
